CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION GeneratePriorityIndex()
RETURNS TABLE (
    ARTregID text,
    art_title text,
    priority_score numeric
) AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        ac.ARTregID,
        ac.art_title,
        ROUND(
            CAST(
                ((COALESCE(ar.HIST_sign, 0) 
                 + COALESCE((ar.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric, 0) 
                 + COALESCE((ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric, 0))
                * (10 - CASE ac.conserve_status
                    WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
                    WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
                    WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
                    WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
                    WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10
                    ELSE 5 END)
            / 30.0 AS numeric), 2
        ) AS priority_score
    FROM ArtifactsCore ac
    LEFT JOIN ArtifactRatings ar ON ac.ARTregID = ar.ART_link;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
